name: openwhispr-cli
title: openwhispr-cli
description: Operates OpenWhispr from the terminal via the `openwhispr` CLI: manage notes, folders, transcriptions and audio, and script dictation workflows against the local desktop app or the cloud API.
why: Local, offline-capable dictation as an agent-operable CLI — a speech-to-text workflow nothing else in the collection covers.
requires: OpenWhispr desktop app (local backend) or cloud account
